lines.text: You are walking the dog when you suddenly think of a great task for your agent.
Fix the flaky checkout test. A good idea, and you want it captured before it fades away.
Typing a long description on a phone with your thumbs? Typo after typo after typo.
So tap the mic and talk. Say the task the way you would tell a teammate.
On a computer, a local Whisper model transcribes your voice inside your browser.
On a phone, it hands off to the dictation your phone already has built in.
On desktop, your voice never leaves your device. Nothing is uploaded, ever.
Your words show up as text. Add a retry, fix a typo, and make it exactly right.
Then send it, and a brand new task appears on your board.
Your agent picks it up, and starts working before you are even back home.
Speaking is much faster than typing, so ideas get captured before they are forgotten.
Capture it in seconds, then enjoy the rest of your walk.
Would you talk to your agents on a walk? Tell us what you would say first, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
